threads.body: The unconditional fallback also runs when the keyed attribute is present but non-string. In that case `_valid_op_and_attr_span_name` rejects a bare operation name, while this helper reports that same bare name as the expected value, recreating the self-contradictory diagnostic this change is intended to remove. Restrict the fallback to an actually absent attribute; malformed values can remain covered by the registry type check as the validation helper's comment intends.

replies.body: Addressed: restricted fallback to absent attributes via not _has_attr(span, attr_key).

threads.body: These findings previously all being grouped together, but now they're separate findings per model. Is this wrong?
